Container.Name: unpackerr
Container.Overview:
Unpackerr extracts completed downloads for Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Readarr, and folder watches.
After install, open the WebUI and add your Starr apps there. Do not put URLs or API keys in environment variables unless you want those fields locked.
Mount Downloads Location with the same container path your Starr apps use (/data or /downloads). Appdata /config holds unpackerr.conf. Extra Parameters --user 99:100 must match Sonarr/Radarr. The golift image does not use PUID/PGID. Docs: https://unpackerr.zip/docs/install/unraid
Container.Changes: v1: Web UI on 5656, /config appdata, configure Starr apps in the UI. Remove old UN_* variables. See https://unpackerr.zip/docs/install/upgrading

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Container Port: 5656 - Unpackerr web UI and HTTP API.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Container Path: /config - unpackerr.conf, logs if you set them here, and UI saves.

Config.Name: Downloads Location
Config.Description: Must match the Starr app download mount. If Starr apps use /data, change this container path to /data.
